[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By placing 1 card in your hand face down as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, if you have as many or fewer security cards as this Digimon has face-down digivolution cards, ＜Recovery +1 ≪Deck≫＞.
